disclaimer: Synthetic corpus and synthetic reference judgments authored from the same controlled vocabulary as the pipeline. These results demonstrate pipeline correctness, deterministic behaviour, regression detection and metric implementation. They are NOT evidence of real-world retrieval quality, clinical accuracy or public-health usefulness.

source_quality.note: Source tier is presentation priority for a verifier, not truth. A tier inversion (a relevant lower-tier chunk presented while an equally relevant higher-tier chunk was not) is descriptive: the ranking multiplies relevance by tier, so it can be legitimate.

generation.caveat: These metrics measure the generation PIPELINE (parsing, citation / anchor / support / safety validators, retry, fallback) driven by a scripted provider. They are not a measure of any language model's quality.

factual_consistency.reason: Factual consistency needs a judge validated against human labels or human review; a deterministic check can prove provenance and form, not truth.

scripted.note: Provider answers are scripted by scenario id. Fallback and rejection rates therefore describe the script, not a language model.

invariants.statement: No forbidden-content output (injection, diagnosis, outbreak confirmation, treatment advice, links, hidden characters, fake roles) is accepted.
invariants.required: 0 accepted of the adversarial cases in these categories

invariants.statement: No fabricated citation or fabricated / mis-attributed anchor is accepted.
No unsupported number or named entity is accepted.
No stale evidence (superseded, withdrawn, expired, not yet valid, published after the as-of date) is presented.
No evidence for another place is presented.
No unverified, non-English, or (in production configuration) synthetic document is presented.
Every scenario's declared hard-negative documents are absent from the presented evidence (and abstaining scenarios present nothing).
Correct abstention: where no relevant eligible evidence exists, nothing is presented, the no_eligible_evidence gap is explicit, no model is called and no explanation is generated.
False confidence: no validated explanation exists for a scenario that presents no evidence.
Every validated explanation opens with the required sentence, cites only bundle ids, and quotes anchors verbatim (independent re-check).
Citation metadata shown with every cited passage equals the stored source metadata.
invariants.required: 100% of cited passages in validated explanations

invariants.statement: A cited document that is superseded, withdrawn or changed after the bundle was built is always detected, and an unchanged corpus produces no stale flag.
Replaying a scenario's stored provider answers through the real pipeline reproduces its status and output hash.
Every adversarial fixture exercised a defence at least once, so a zero is not vacuous.
All eleven required adversarial categories ran.

pending.description: Relevance of retrieved evidence on a real, curated, licence-checked corpus (graded 0/1/2) by at least two public-health raters, with inter-rater agreement.
Whether generated statements are clinically and epidemiologically accurate and not misleading, rated by epidemiology / public-health experts.
Whether the evidence and explanation actually help a district surveillance officer verify an emerging signal.
Whether the presentation-priority ordering of source classes is appropriate for verification.
Quality of any Hindi or Odia output. No Hindi or Odia text is generated in M4; this stays pending until such output exists and native-speaker reviewers rate it.
